Clara P: Quick sync - product launched a new autotune feature; marketing wants 1-pager + quick rebuts vs infra vendors. Need something short for SDRs.
Omar T: We should call out that autotune reduces per-request cost by adjusting batching/kv cache based on traffic patterns. One-liner? 'Autotune: lower unit cost without manual configs.'
Lee H: For battlecard rebuts: infra vendor pitch: 'We give deep customization.' -> Rebuttal: 'Customization matters, but operational guardrails and rollout primitives determine safety. Redwood ships both.'
Clara P: Routing for ops-bot: if lead mentions 'autotune' or 'autoscale' route to #product-special.
ops-bot: Note - new tag 'product-special' created.
Omar T: SDR 30s: 'Hi, I'm Omar at Redwood. Our autotune feature moves cost and latency to the control plane so you can hit SLOs without manual tuning. Quick Q: do you currently tune instance configs for traffic spikes?'
Lee H: Add to battlecard: two quick metrics: median latency improvement and cost delta on sample workload. Keep anonymized.
Clara P: I'll assemble the one-pager and loop in product for numbers.
